summary: All 3 repair targets are valid. Pending draft questions should contain only the question text; recommendation and rationale will be presented during the Q&A turn.

items.title: 1. q1 includes recommendation and rationale
items.rationale: The pending QA schema requires unanswered questions to leave answer, evidence, why, and considered empty. The question text should not embed the recommended answer or its rationale.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[0].question includes the question plus '推奨は SDD flow skill の手順強化です' and rationale text.

items.title: 2. q2 includes recommendation and rationale
items.rationale: The pending QA entry should ask only for the decision. The recommendation and supporting test evidence belong in the user-facing choice presentation or answered QA fields after the user decision.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[1].question includes the question plus '推奨は両方を含めることです' and current test evidence.

items.title: 3. q3 includes recommendation and rationale
items.rationale: The pending QA entry should stay self-contained without embedding the answer. The scope recommendation can be shown when asking the user.
items.evidence: draft.json qa[2].question includes the question plus a recommended scope and rationale.
